subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Which remaining pieces of this bundled request should OpenClaw core own now, and should they be split into separate docs/product follow-ups?
rationale: The still-missing parts change stable setup, update, auth, and audit behavior; automation cannot safely choose the product scope or whether a unified audit surface should exist.

options.title: Split focused core follow-ups
options.body: Keep this open as an umbrella or replace it with narrow items for systemd SecretRef docs, update diff reporting, and audit-scope design while avoiding already-implemented paths.

options.title: Sponsor one broader CLI/audit design
options.body: Treat this as a cohesive product initiative and assign an owner to define the update and audit contract before implementation.

options.title: Close residual requests as not planned
options.body: If maintainers decide the current docs, dry-run, and audit surfaces are sufficient, close this with that product decision and point users to existing commands.

recommendation.title: Split focused core follow-ups
recommendation.body: Keep this open as an umbrella or replace it with narrow items for systemd SecretRef docs, update diff reporting, and audit-scope design while avoiding already-implemented paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for update dry-run and config audit design points to @steipete, and those are central to deciding the remaining product scope.
